title: Why Superbugs Could Rival Cancer By 2050
hook: Drug resistance is turning routine infections into a global killing threat.
closing: Using antibiotics carefully now can keep ordinary infections treatable later.
question: Does antibiotic resistance worry you?

segments.say: Drug resistance directly killed 1.27 million people in 2019. The threat is already global.
By 2050, resistant infections are projected to kill 10 million yearly. The toll could rise nearly eightfold.
That projected 10 million equals today's annual cancer deaths. Superbugs could become a cancer-sized killer.
